label: HANDOFF EXAMPLE, REDACTED. Built from the archived 0.001 USDC Arc Testnet purchase of 2026-11-19 (samples/arc-gateway-live-pay.json, samples/arc-gateway-live-refresh.json). No new payment was made to produce it.

provenanceKey.LIVE: returned by Circle Gateway or Arc Testnet during the archived run
provenanceKey.LIVE_RUN: generated by Verity code during the archived live run (buyer or in-process merchant)
provenanceKey.FIXTURE: comes from fixture analysis or fixture evidence bytes
provenanceKey.DERIVED: computed for this handoff; the archived run did not emit it

runId.note: The archived runner emitted no runId. This value is 'arc-gateway-pay-' plus the merchant's verifiedAt time. Format is a pending decision.

purchaseId.note: sha256(payer address | proposal_id), first 24 hex. The proposal_id came from the FIXTURE NYC analysis.

receiptDigest.note: Digest of DeliveryReceiptV2, signed by the live seller key 0x0B5343FD96AF324B789fbd980f177241B7455b05. The receipt binds the FIXTURE content hash.

circleTransferId.role: Circle identifies the individual transfer: payer, payTo, 1000 base units, authorization nonce. settle().transaction returned the same UUID.

arcBatchTxHash.role: Circle reported this batch transaction for the transfer. QuickNode confirms the Arc batch receipt; it cannot attribute one transfer inside the batch.

quicknodeConfirmation.note: No QuickNode call was made: it uses account credits, and the QuickNode key returned 403 earlier.

interimCheck.source: Arc Testnet public RPC https://rpc.testnet.arc.io (not QuickNode), read-only, 2026-11-19

fixtureIds.catalogItemId: cat-nws-cli-settlement-version-nano-v1 (shared catalog entry, approved only for the fixture market)
fixtureIds.merchantId: verity-demo-merchant (shared catalog identity; the live seller signs under it)
fixtureIds.contentHash: 0x6d23d9b65eb865628e66959c4e3d55e221e6eab300c89e90c834e5f4e9d964ca (keccak256 of FIXTURE evidence bytes, labelled FIXTURE inside the document)

portalCalls.note: Shapes follow portal/README.md on branch verity-audit-portal. Values are the archived ones.

POST /purchases.salt: REDACTED (kept in the buyer database only)

timeline.event: merchant verified the paid request; Gateway verify valid, settle success
DeliveryReceiptV2 issued; buyer verified receipt and bytes; ledger accepted_by_gateway, pending_batch
batch transaction mined in block 72968478 (323 s after settle)
refresh saw transfer completed with the batch tx; ledger batch_settled, reservation spent

redacted: private keys (never present in any report)
receipt signature (verifiable from samples/arc-gateway-live-pay.json if needed)
local bearer session token (random per process, never stored)
